feeds.title: Hawaii Mom Blog
feeds.description: At Hawaii Mom Blog, you'll find us sharing our passions for food, travel, fashion, and more. We have covered the red carpet, traveled 885 meters above sea level into the clouds, indulged in a dinner fit for royalty, and zipped across farms on the North Shore!

feeds.title: Hawaii Travel with Kids Blogs
feeds.description: Plan your perfect trip to Hawaii without all the stress. We bring you the best restaurants, activities, adventures, hotel reviews, packing lists, cultural events, and more that everyone in your family will love.

feeds.title: gigi-hawaii
feeds.description: A blog by Glenda Chung Hinchey. I am a third-generation Korean-American, born and raised in Hawaii. My interests include classical music, Broadway musicals, art museums, Hawaii, New York, Europe, Thailand, Korea, beautifying our home, enjoying married and family life, and blogging.

feeds.title: Monica Swanson Blog
feeds.description: Blog topics cover parenting, motherhood, kids' health, career, character training, and more. Monica Swanson is a Hawaii living Mom to 4 groms, (surfer boys) married to Dr. Dave.

feeds.title: Hawaii In Real Life
feeds.description: A Hawaii blog about local culture, entertainment, food, restaurants, family, movie reviews, photography, technology, parenting, fashion, travel, and Aloha spirit.

feeds.title: A Maui Blog
feeds.description: My name is Liza Pierce and I have been living in Maui since 1994. I started blogging as a Mommy Blogger in 2005. I like talking about Maui stories with Visitors and locals alike and I want to share Maui with you. I want you not only to enjoy Maui but also to love and take care of it.
